nl: Create out/price.txt containing exactly this line: Total: $5 (50%) - run `make` and "check"
oracle_program: write "out/price.txt" "Total: $5 (50%) - run `make` and \"check\"\n" mode: create parents: true
reference_bash: mkdir -p out && printf '%s\n' 'Total: $5 (50%) - run `make` and "check"' > out/price.txt

negatives.script: mkdir -p out && echo "Total: $5 (50%) - run `make` and "check"" > out/price.txt
negatives.defect: the shell expands $5 and the backquotes
